We believe in their right to exist. We stand with them because they’re our friends, but also because they represent democratic values. Our support is both military and diplomatic. When Israeli forces take actions that may violate international law or cause excessive civilian casualties, we must speak up. We cannot let humanitarian concerns fall by the wayside. At the same time, we must recognize the existential threat Israel faces—the attacks on October 7th were horrific, and they've shown us how fragile security can be. So yes, we should support Israel, but we should do so responsibly."
